text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan's next race is an international Gâ  in Dubai, huh...
I wonder when she'll run domestically again.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, after Dubai, isn't the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe totally on the table?
Everyone's expecting it!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(The public is in a frenzy over
what kind of mess Ai-san is gonna pull next...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (She really is a star of the era. ...Still—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I don't have the luxury to be worrying about that.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (For my part, starting from today's race, I'll aim for it once again...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Never run away, never fear, charge straight at any opponent!
Become an invincible 'Queen' like that!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: Alright, let's start our comeback right here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Many Umamusume who ran in the Classic Triple Crown races
are competing in today's Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Including the Senior Class veterans, this race will be the first real test to see how well the current Lucky Lilac can compete—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll give it everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Alright~, let's nail it with a bang!!
If we start off cold, even good jokes won't land!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(First, I gotta make a statement here at Nakayama!!
Then I'll be riding high! On the road to my comeback!!)
